entries.author: JOANNES ZONARAS
entries.title: Caroli Ducangii Praefatio, in qua de Joannis Zonarae scriptis et rebus gestis
entries.note: Head 'DUCANGII PRAEFATIO' at line 256; Ordo 9. Col 9 precedes the first mapped anchor (13, header '13 PRAEFATIO 14' at 395), so it rests on Elenchus+Ordo agreement and position.

entries.author: JOANNES ZONARAS
entries.title: Hieronymi Wolfii Praefatio
entries.note: Elenchus OCR '21'; Ordo '27'. Head 'HIERONYMI WOLFII ... JOANNIS ZONARAE ANNALES PRAEFATIO' at 959 on page 27|28 (header at 912; 29|30 header at 977). 21 would fall inside Du Cange's preface. Body-confirmed 27.

entries.author: JOANNES ZONARAS
entries.title: Annales
entries.note: Elenchus OCR '9', Ordo '$9' (leading 3 lost). Greek 'IOANNOU TOU ZONARA CHRONIKON' (1347) and 'JOANNIS ZONARAE ANNALES. PRAEFATIO' (1349-1352) follow a bare '99' (= 39) at line 1321, after Wolfii's Preface ends (1335). Includes the author's Praefatio (Ordo 'Praefatio auctoris 59') on 39ff; Liber primus head at line 2069 on 51|52 (Ordo '8I'). Parts from the Ordo as read, not body-confirmed; Ordo digits are unreliable here (3 for 5/8 etc).

problems: Ordo-only editorial item not entered: 'Monitum ejusdem lectori' (Ordo 26; body head 'LECTORI' line 899, page 25|26).
Ordo column digits are heavily garbled (2223, 12092, $81, 8I, »iS); parts not body-confirmed. Whether the later books run past Liber XV into the volume's end is not checked.
